title: Juniperus communis cream for medicinal use
intro: Juniperus communis cream is a topical preparation made from the dried berries of the common juniper plant. It is traditionally used in herbalism to support urinary tract health and as a diuretic. The cream may help alleviate symptoms of bladder infections and promote kidney function. It is often applied externally to the lower abdomen or back to ease discomfort. This preparation is valued for its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties in natural medicine.
